title: Does't sync with ios health app
body: I paid for it specifically for synching with the health app but even iam sure all permissions are allowed it doesn't sync, the app itself is great, but as i said my main goal is synching with ios health and i can't, it always gives me the same message all the time.
author: Kareem ezz alarab

title: Best app so far
body: I have been searching for a habit tracking app that is minimalist yet provide every service and I finally found awesom habits. It did genuinely help with staying on track bc of the alarms and trend and streaks
